# Add prepaid-credit top-up billing

Usage-based offerings need a `"topUp"` billing cycle backed by the existing customer wallet. The create and read contracts use string fields `topUpAmount` and optional `topUpThreshold`; the threshold defaults to `"0.2"`. A top-up amount is required for this billing cycle, top-up fields are invalid on other cycles, and subscription offerings cannot use it. Persist and return these fields without changing existing offering behavior.

Create one hourly scheduler per top-up offering. Enrollment and every hourly check must refill a wallet only when its balance is below `topUpThreshold * topUpAmount`, charging exactly the gap to `topUpAmount` through an invoice whose payment is stored as credit. Hourly usage must be deducted as a wallet transaction even when it exceeds the current balance; it must not generate a separate usage invoice. After the deduction, evaluate the refill using the updated balance. Preserve normal monthly and annual billing, invoice payment, and credit behavior.

Keep this behavior on the existing offering boundaries. A top-up offering must expose `topUp({ customer })`. Its hourly schedule must use `SupportedMeasurementFrequencies.everyHour`, carry `businessID` and `offeringId` in `scheduleParameters`, and use one stable offering-level `schedulerID` rather than a customer-specific ID. `topUp` must treat a balance exactly at the threshold as sufficient; below it, create one invoice with `storePaymentAsCredit: true` and one line item named `<offering name> - Top Up`, quantity `1`, and unit cost `topUpAmount - current balance`. The hourly path may use the existing `OfferingTopUpChecker` or the offering's billing flow, but it must record the full negative usage through `CreditService.create`, update the in-memory balance, and then call `topUp`. Zero usage still evaluates top-up but creates no credit transaction.

Verify with:

    cd /app && npm run build && npm run test:ci -- --runInBand

89:     static determineBillingSecondsInBillingCycle({
90:         billingCycle,
91:         date,
92:     }: {
93:         billingCycle: ValidBillingCycles;
94:         date?: Date;
95:     }): number | void {
96:         if (date) {
97:             if (billingCycle === ValidBillingCycles.monthly) {
98:                 return DatetimeUtils.totalMiliSecondsInMonthGivenDay(date);
99:             }
100:             if (billingCycle === ValidBillingCycles.annualToDate) {

102:             }
103:         }
104:     }
105:     static determineRemainingMinimumCharge({
106:         startDate,
107:         endDate,
108:         price,
109:         exchangeRate,
110:         negative,
111:         billingCycle,
112:     }: {
113:         startDate: Date;
114:         endDate: Date;
115:         price: number;
116:         exchangeRate: number;
117:         negative: boolean;
118:         billingCycle: ValidBillingCycles;
119:     }): number {
120:         const billingMSSeconds: number = Math.round(Math.abs(endDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime()));
121:         const billingMSSecondsInBillingCycle = Offering.determineBillingSecondsInBillingCycle({
122:             billingCycle,
123:             date: startDate,
124:         });
125:         if (typeof billingMSSecondsInBillingCycle === 'number') {
126:             const amountDue: number =
127:                 Math.round(
128:                     100 *
129:                         price *
130:                         exchangeRate *
131:                         (billingMSSeconds / billingMSSecondsInBillingCycle) *
132:                         (negative ? -1 : 1),
133:                 ) / 100;
134: 
135:             return amountDue;
136:         } else {
137:             AuditService.publishEvent({
138:                 data: [
139:                     {
140:                         message: 'Failed to determine billing seconds in billing cycle',
141:                         startDate,
142:                         endDate,
143:                         price,
144:                         exchangeRate,
145:                         negative,
146:                         billingCycle,
147:                     },
148:                 ],
149:                 message: 'Failed to determine billing seconds in billing cycle',
150:                 topic: AuditScope.ERROR,
151:             });
152:             throw new Error('Failed to determine billing seconds in billing cycle');
153:         }
154:     }
155:     static minimumChargeOverride({
156:         minimumCharge,
157:         lineItems,
158:         freeTrialEndDate,
159:         offeringName,
160:         isUnenrollment,
161:         startDate,
162:         endDate,
163:         exchangeRate,
164:         offeringEnrollmentDate,
165:         billingCycle,
166:     }: {
167:         minimumCharge: number;
168:         lineItems: InvoiceLineItems;
169:         freeTrialEndDate?: string;
170:         offeringName: string;
171:         isUnenrollment?: boolean;
172:         startDate: Date;
173:         endDate: Date;
174:         exchangeRate: number;
175:         offeringEnrollmentDate: Date;
176:         billingCycle: ValidBillingCycles;
177:     }): InvoiceLineItems {
178:         // If the total of all line items is less than the minimum charge, then we return a new InvoiceLineItems with the minimum charge as the only lineItem
179:         // Otherwise, we return the original lineItems
180:         const total = lineItems.getTotal();
181:         if (minimumCharge) {
182:             let minimumChargeAmountDue: number;
183:             if (isUnenrollment) {
184:                 minimumChargeAmountDue = Offering.determineRemainingMinimumCharge({
185:                     startDate:
186:                         offeringEnrollmentDate &&
187:                         DatetimeUtils.dateIsBetweenTwoDates(offeringEnrollmentDate, startDate, endDate)
188:                             ? DatetimeUtils.beginningOfDay(offeringEnrollmentDate)
189:                             : startDate,
190:                     endDate,
191:                     exchangeRate,
192:                     negative: false,
193:                     price: minimumCharge,
194:                     billingCycle,
195:                 });
196:             } else if (
197:                 offeringEnrollmentDate &&
198:                 DatetimeUtils.dateIsBetweenTwoDates(offeringEnrollmentDate, startDate, endDate)
199:             ) {
200:                 minimumChargeAmountDue = Offering.determineRemainingMinimumCharge({
201:                     startDate: DatetimeUtils.beginningOfDay(offeringEnrollmentDate),
202:                     endDate,
203:                     exchangeRate,
204:                     negative: false,
205:                     price: minimumCharge,
206:                     billingCycle,
207:                 });
208:             } else {
209:                 minimumChargeAmountDue = minimumCharge;
210:             }
211:             if (total < minimumChargeAmountDue) {
212:                 const lineItemObj = new InvoiceLineItems();
213:                 lineItemObj.addLineItem(
214:                     new InvoiceLineItem(`${offeringName} (Minimum Fee)`, 1, minimumChargeAmountDue),
215:                 );
216: 
217:                 if (freeTrialEndDate && !DatetimeUtils.isDateInPast(new Date(freeTrialEndDate))) {
218:                     lineItemObj.addLineItem(
219:                         new InvoiceLineItem(
220:                             `${offeringName} (Minimum Fee) - Free Trial`,
221:                             1,
222:                             -1 * minimumChargeAmountDue,
223:                         ),
224:                     );
225:                 }
226:                 return lineItemObj;
227:             } else {
228:                 return lineItems;
229:             }
230:         } else {
231:             return lineItems;
232:         }
233:     }

352:     static async getLineItemsForUsage({
353:         startDate,
354:         endDate,
355:         customer,
356:         lineItems,
357:         negative,
358:         businessID,
359:         customerId,
360:         customerService,
361:         dimensions,
362:         offeringInstance,
363:         proratedStartDate,
364:     }: {
365:         startDate: Date;
366:         endDate: Date;
367:         customer?: ReadCustomerResponseData;
368:         lineItems: InvoiceLineItems;
369:         negative?: boolean;
370:         businessID: string;
371:         customerId: string;
372:         customerService: CustomerService;
373:         dimensions: ReadOfferingResponseData['dimensions'];
374:         offeringInstance: Offering;
375:         proratedStartDate?: Date;
376:     }): Promise<InvoiceLineItems> {
377:         let usage: { data: (AggregatedUsageResponse | MetadataGroupedAggregatedUsageResponse)[] };
378:         if (offeringInstance.usageOverrides && offeringInstance.usageOverrides?.length) {
379:             usage = { data: offeringInstance.usageOverrides };
380:         } else {
381:             const res = await customerService.findUsageForCustomer(
382:                 {
383:                     businessID,
384:                     customerId,
385:                     customer,
386:                 },
387:                 {
388:                     startTime: startDate.toISOString(),
389:                     endTime: endDate.toISOString(),
390:                 },
391:             );
392:             usage = res as { data: (AggregatedUsageResponse | MetadataGroupedAggregatedUsageResponse)[] };
393:         }
394: 
395:         const aggregateUsageData = usage?.data;
396:         const tieredDimensionMap: Record<string, ReadDimensionResponseData> = {};
397:         const groupedDimensionMap: Record<string, ReadDimensionResponseData> = {};
398:         const nonTieredDimensionsMap: Record<string, ReadDimensionResponseData> = {};
399:         dimensions.map((dimension) => {
400:             if (dimension?.tiers && dimension?.tiers?.length) {
401:                 tieredDimensionMap[dimension.dimensionId] = dimension;
402:             } else if (dimension?.tiersGroupByMetadata) {
403:                 groupedDimensionMap[dimension.dimensionId] = dimension;
404:             } else if (
405:                 (dimension?.consumptionPrice !== undefined && dimension?.consumptionPrice !== null) ||
406:                 (dimension?.usageEntitlement !== undefined && dimension?.usageEntitlement !== null)
407:             ) {
408:                 nonTieredDimensionsMap[dimension.dimensionId] = dimension;
409:             }
410:         });
411:         const aggreatedUsageDataDimensionMap = aggregateUsageData.reduce(
412:             (acc, item) => {
413:                 if ((<MetadataGroupedAggregatedUsageResponse>item)?.metadataGroup) {
414:                     const keys = Object.keys((<MetadataGroupedAggregatedUsageResponse>item).metadataGroup);
415:                     const uniqueGroupId = keys.reduce((acc, key) => {
416:                         acc += key + (<MetadataGroupedAggregatedUsageResponse>item).metadataGroup[key];
417:                         return acc;
418:                     }, '');
419:                     acc[uniqueGroupId] = item;
420:                 } else {
421:                     acc[item.dimensionId] = item;
422:                 }
423:                 return acc;
424:             },
425:             {} as Record<string, AggregatedUsageResponse | MetadataGroupedAggregatedUsageResponse>,
426:         );
427:         const dimensionTotals = Object.keys(nonTieredDimensionsMap).reduce((acc, nonTieredDimensionId) => {
428:             const usageElement = aggreatedUsageDataDimensionMap[nonTieredDimensionId];
429:             const dimension = nonTieredDimensionsMap[nonTieredDimensionId];
430:             let total;
431:             if (dimension?.aggregationMethod === aggregationMethod.last) {
432:                 if (usageElement && usageElement?.usage?.length) {
433:                     total = Billing.usageToTotal(
434:                         {
435:                             usage: [
436:                                 usageElement?.usage[usageElement?.usage?.length ? usageElement?.usage?.length - 1 : 0],
437:                             ],
438:                             dimensionId: usageElement.dimensionId,
439:                         },
440:                         dimension,
441:                     );
442:                 } else {
443:                     total = Billing.usageToTotal(
444:                         {
445:                             usage: [],
446:                             dimensionId: dimension?.dimensionId,
447:                         },
448:                         dimension,
449:                     );
450:                 }
451:             } else {
452:                 if (usageElement) {
453:                     total = Billing.usageToTotal(usageElement, dimension);
454:                 } else {
455:                     total = Billing.usageToTotal(
456:                         {
457:                             usage: [],
458:                             dimensionId: dimension?.dimensionId,
459:                         },
460:                         dimension,
461:                     );
462:                 }
463:             }
464: 
465:             if (acc[nonTieredDimensionId]) {
466:                 acc[nonTieredDimensionId] += parseFloat(total);
467:                 acc[nonTieredDimensionId] = acc[nonTieredDimensionId].toFixed(2);
468:             } else {
469:                 acc[nonTieredDimensionId] = parseFloat(total);
470:                 acc[nonTieredDimensionId] = acc[nonTieredDimensionId].toFixed(2);
471:             }
472: 
473:             return acc;
474:         }, {}) as Record<string, number>;
475:         let exchangeRate = 1;
476: 
477:         if (Offering.getCurrency({ customer, offering: offeringInstance }) !== SupportedCurrencies.USD) {
478:             console.log('Inside exchange rate');
479:             exchangeRate = await AnalyticsService.getExchangeRate({
480:                 currency: Offering.getCurrency({ customer, offering: offeringInstance }),
481:             });
482:             lineItems.addTerms(
483:                 `Invoice dynamically calculated with realtime currency exchange rate €${exchangeRate.toFixed(
484:                     2,
485:                 )} = $1.00`,
486:             );
487:         }
488: 
489:         Object.keys(dimensionTotals).forEach((dimensionId) => {
490:             let unitCost = Number(
491:                 (parseFloat(nonTieredDimensionsMap[dimensionId].consumptionPrice) * exchangeRate).toFixed(
492:                     Offering.getDecimalsForNumber(parseFloat(nonTieredDimensionsMap[dimensionId].consumptionPrice)) ===
493:                         0
494:                         ? 2
495:                         : Offering.getDecimalsForNumber(
496:                               parseFloat(nonTieredDimensionsMap[dimensionId].consumptionPrice),
497:                           ),
498:                 ),
499:             );
500:             if (nonTieredDimensionsMap[dimensionId]?.paymentSchedule === PaymentSchedule.upfront) {
501:                 const billingMSStartDate = proratedStartDate ? proratedStartDate : startDate;
502:                 const billingMSSeconds: number = Math.round(Math.abs(endDate.getTime() - billingMSStartDate.getTime()));
503:                 const billingMSSecondsInBillingCycle = Offering.determineBillingSecondsInBillingCycle({
504:                     date: billingMSStartDate,
505:                     billingCycle: offeringInstance?.billingCycle,
506:                 }) as number;
507:                 unitCost = Math.round(100 * unitCost * (billingMSSeconds / billingMSSecondsInBillingCycle)) / 100;
508:             }
509:             const shouldDisplayLineItem = Billing.determineIfLineItemShown({
510:                 Offering: offeringInstance,
511:                 dimension: nonTieredDimensionsMap[dimensionId],
512:                 totalUsage: dimensionTotals[dimensionId] as number,
513:                 unitCost,
514:                 freeDimensionOnInvoice: offeringInstance.settings?.freeDimensionOnInvoice,
515:             });
516:             if (shouldDisplayLineItem) {
517:                 const {
518:                     usageIncrement,
519:                     consumptionUnit: { unit, type },
520:                 } = nonTieredDimensionsMap[dimensionId];
521:                 // Handle currency conversion
522: 
523:                 const { displayName, total: displayTotal } = InvoiceLineItem.prepareLineItem({
524:                     total: dimensionTotals[dimensionId],
525:                     dimensionType: type,
526:                     dimensionId,
527:                     dimensionName: nonTieredDimensionsMap[dimensionId].dimensionName,
528:                     offeringName: offeringInstance.offeringName,
529:                     usageIncrement: parseInt(usageIncrement),
530:                     dimensionUnit: unit,
531:                     negative,
532:                 });
533:                 lineItems.addLineItem(new InvoiceLineItem(displayName, displayTotal, unitCost));
534:             }
535:         });
536:         if (Object.keys(tieredDimensionMap).length) {
537:             Object.keys(tieredDimensionMap).forEach((tieredDimensionId) => {
538:                 const tieredDimension = tieredDimensionMap[tieredDimensionId];
539:                 const usageElement = aggreatedUsageDataDimensionMap[tieredDimensionId];
540:                 const sortedTiers = tieredDimension.tiers.sort((a, b) => {
541:                     return parseFloat(a.tierPosition) - parseFloat(b.tierPosition);
542:                 });
543:                 let priorTier: DimensionTierDto;
544:                 let remainingUsage = usageElement?.usage.reduce((acc, { value }) => {
545:                     acc += parseFloat(value);
546:                     return acc;
547:                 }, 0);
548:                 sortedTiers.forEach((tier, index) => {

551:                     }

553:                     let lowerBound = 0;
554:                     if (priorTier) {
555:                         lowerBound = parseFloat(priorTier.upperBound);
556:                     } else {
557:                         lowerBound = 0;
558:                     }
559:                     let difference;
560:                     if (upperBound === 'inf') {
561:                         difference = remainingUsage;
562:                     } else if (index === 0 && tieredDimension?.usageEntitlement) {
563:                         if (tieredDimension?.usageEntitlement === 'inf') {
564:                             difference = remainingUsage;
565:                         } else {
566:                             difference = (tieredDimension?.usageEntitlement as number) - lowerBound;
567:                         }
568:                     } else {
569:                         difference = parseFloat(upperBound) - lowerBound;
570:                     }
571:                     let usageInTier;
572:                     let unitCost;
573:                     if (tier?.unitPrice) {
574:                         unitCost = Number(
575:                             (parseFloat(tier?.unitPrice) * exchangeRate).toFixed(
576:                                 Offering.getDecimalsForNumber(parseFloat(tier?.unitPrice)) === 0
577:                                     ? 2
578:                                     : Offering.getDecimalsForNumber(parseFloat(tier?.unitPrice)),
579:                             ),
580:                         );
581:                         if (tieredDimension?.paymentSchedule === PaymentSchedule.upfront) {
582:                             const billingMSStartDate = proratedStartDate ? proratedStartDate : startDate;
583:                             const billingMSSeconds: number = Math.round(
584:                                 Math.abs(endDate.getTime() - billingMSStartDate.getTime()),
585:                             );
586:                             const billingMSSecondsInBillingCycle = Offering.determineBillingSecondsInBillingCycle({
587:                                 date: billingMSStartDate,
588:                                 billingCycle: offeringInstance?.billingCycle,
589:                             }) as number;
590:                             unitCost =
591:                                 Math.round(100 * unitCost * (billingMSSeconds / billingMSSecondsInBillingCycle)) / 100;
592:                         }
593:                     } else {
594:                         unitCost = Number(0);
595:                     }
596:                     if (remainingUsage - difference > 0) {
597:                         usageInTier = difference;
598:                         const { displayName, total: displayTotal } = InvoiceLineItem.prepareLineItem({
599:                             total: usageInTier,
600:                             dimensionType: tieredDimension?.consumptionUnit?.type,
601:                             dimensionId: tieredDimensionId,

603:                             offeringName: offeringInstance.offeringName,

605:                             dimensionUnit: tieredDimension?.consumptionUnit?.unit,
606:                             negative,
607:                             tieredName: tier?.tierName,
608:                         });
609:                         lineItems.addLineItem(new InvoiceLineItem(displayName, displayTotal, unitCost));
610:                         remainingUsage -= difference;
611:                     } else {
612:                         usageInTier = remainingUsage;
613:                         const { displayName, total: displayTotal } = InvoiceLineItem.prepareLineItem({
614:                             total: usageInTier,

616:                             dimensionId: tieredDimensionId,
617:                             dimensionName: tieredDimension?.dimensionName,

1531:     async processBilling(
1532:         startDateOverride?: Date,

1536:         let startDate: Date;

1539:         startDate = startDateOverride ? startDateOverride : new Date(startTime);

1547:         UsageBased.logger.log(
1548:             `Processing billing for ${
1549:                 this.offeringName
1550:             } from ${startDate.toISOString()} to ${endDate.toISOString()}, with free trial end date ${
1551:                 this.freeTrialEndDate
1552:             }`,
1553:         );
1554:         if (
1555:             this.freeTrialEndDate &&
1556:             DatetimeUtils.dateIsBetweenTwoDates(new Date(this.freeTrialEndDate), startDate, endDate)
1557:         ) {

1569:             });
1570:         } else if (
1571:             this.freeTrialEndDate &&
1572:             DatetimeUtils.dateIsBetweenTwoDates(endDate, startDate, new Date(this.freeTrialEndDate))
1573:         ) {
1574:             // The customer is currently in a free trial
1575:             await Offering.getLineItemsForUsage({
1576:                 startDate,
1577:                 endDate,
1578:                 customer,
1579:                 lineItems,
1580:                 negative: true,
1581:                 businessID: this.businessID,
1582:                 customerId: this.customerId,
1583:                 customerService: this.customerService,
1584:                 offeringInstance: this,
1585:                 dimensions: this.dimensions,
1586:             });
1587:         }
1588: 
1589:         await Offering.getLineItemsForUsage({
1590:             startDate,
1591:             endDate,
1592:             customer,
1593:             lineItems,
1594:             negative: false,
1595:             businessID: this.businessID,
1596:             customerId: this.customerId,
1597:             customerService: this.customerService,
1598:             offeringInstance: this,
1599:             dimensions: this.dimensions,
1600:         });
1601:         UsageBased.logger.log(
1602:             `Creating invoice for ${this.offeringName} for ${this.customerId}, lineItems: ${JSON.stringify(
1603:                 lineItems.getLineItems(),
1604:             )}`,
1605:         );
1606:         let exchangeRate = 1;
1607:         if (Offering.getCurrency({ customer, offering: this }) !== SupportedCurrencies.USD) {
1608:             exchangeRate = await AnalyticsService.getExchangeRate({
1609:                 currency: Offering.getCurrency({ customer, offering: this }),
1610:             });
1611:         }
1612:         const endLineItems = Offering.minimumChargeOverride({
1613:             billingCycle: this.billingCycle,
1614:             minimumCharge: this.minimumCharge,
1615:             lineItems,
1616:             freeTrialEndDate: this.freeTrialEndDate,
1617:             offeringName: this.offeringName,
1618:             isUnenrollment: this.isUnenrollment,
1619:             startDate,
1620:             endDate,
1621:             exchangeRate,
1622:             offeringEnrollmentDate: customer?.offeringEnrollmentDate
1623:                 ? new Date(customer?.offeringEnrollmentDate)
1624:                 : undefined,
1625:         });
1626:         if (this?.discount?.name) {
1627:             Offering.addDiscountLineItem(this.discount, endLineItems);
1628:         }
1629:         const invoiceInput = {
1630:             businessID: this.businessID,
1631:             customer: customer,
1632:             customerId: this.customerId,
1633:             items: endLineItems,
1634:             invoiceDate: this.isEnrollment ? new Date().toISOString() : endDate.toISOString(),
1635:             currency: Offering.getCurrency({ customer, offering: this }),
1636:         };
1637:         UsageBased.logger.debug(
1638:             `Finished Invoice Input, processing with the following parameters: QueueInvoice: ${this.queueInvoice}, Consolidate Invoice: ${this.consolidatedInvoice}`,
1639:         );
1640:         if (this.queueInvoice) {
1641:             await this.invoicesService.queueInvoice(invoiceInput);
1642:         } else if (!this.consolidatedInvoice) {
1643:             const { invoiceId } = await this.invoicesService.create(invoiceInput);
1644:             return invoiceId;
1645:         }
1646:         if (this.consolidatedInvoice) {
1647:             const { invoiceId } = await this.invoicesService.consolidateInvoice({
1648:                 startTime: this.isUnenrollment
1649:                     ? await this.determineStartTimeForInvoiceConsolidation({
1650:                           customerId: this.customerId,
1651:                           businessID: this.businessID,
1652:                           billingCycleStartTime: currentBillingCycleStartTime,
1653:                       })
1654:                     : startTime,
1655:                 endTime: this.isUnenrollment ? new Date().toISOString() : endTime,
1656:                 customerId: this.customerId,
1657:                 businessID: this.businessID,
1658:                 invoiceDate: endDate.toISOString(),
1659:                 initalLineItems: !this.queueInvoice ? endLineItems : undefined,
1660:             });
1661:             return invoiceId;
1662:         }
1663:         return;
1664:     }
1665:     async determineStartTimeForInvoiceConsolidation({
1666:         customerId,
1667:         businessID,
1668:         billingCycleStartTime,
1669:     }: {
1670:         customerId: string;
1671:         businessID: string;
1672:         billingCycleStartTime: string;
1673:     }) {
1674:         const ledger = await this.customerService.getCustomerLedger({ customerId, businessID });
1675:         let startTime = billingCycleStartTime;
1676:         // Assumes that the ledger is sorted by date in descending order
1677:         if (ledger?.data) {
1678:             // Checks to see the last time a customer has had no offering associated with their account.
1679:             // If that time is before the start of the current billing cycle, then the start time is the start of the current billing cycle
1680:             // If that time is during the current billing cycle we use that start time.
1681:             // Prevents the case of a customer cancelling plans regularlly and then re-enrolling in the same billing cycle,
1682:             // which would cause the invoice to be consolidated with incorrect values
1683:             for (const item of ledger.data) {
1684:                 if (!item?.offeringId) {
1685:                     if (new Date(startTime).getTime() < new Date(item._time).getTime()) {
1686:                         startTime = item._time;
1687:                         break;
1688:                     } else {
1689:                         break;
1690:                     }
1691:                 }
1692:             }
1693:         }
1694:         return startTime;
1695:     }

1697:     async unenroll({ customer, isChangeOfPlan }): Promise<void> {
1698:         const { currentBillingCycleStartTime } = Billing.billingCycleToTimeRange(this.billingCycle);
1699:         UsageBased.logger.debug(
1700:             `Running Unenrollment for Customer: ${customer?.customerId}, isChangeOfPlan: ${isChangeOfPlan}, currentBillingCycleStartTime: ${currentBillingCycleStartTime}, settingsInvoiceGeneration: ${this.settings?.invoiceGeneration}`,
1701:         );
1702:         UsageBased.logger.debug(
1703:             `BooleanCheck: ${
1704:                 isChangeOfPlan && this.settings?.invoiceGeneration === InvoiceGeneration.consolidatedPerBillingCycle
1705:             }`,
1706:         );
1707:         if (this.settings?.invoiceGeneration === InvoiceGeneration.consolidatedPerBillingCycle) {
1708:             this.queueInvoice = true;
1709:         }
1710:         if (!isChangeOfPlan && this.settings?.invoiceGeneration === InvoiceGeneration.consolidatedPerBillingCycle) {
1711:             this.consolidatedInvoice = true;
1712:         }
1713:         UsageBased.logger.debug(`Setting queueInvoice to ${this.queueInvoice}`);
1714:         UsageBased.logger.debug(`Setting consolidatedInvoice to ${this.consolidatedInvoice}`);
1715:         this.isUnenrollment = true;
1716:         await this.processBilling(new Date(currentBillingCycleStartTime), new Date(), customer);
1717:         await this.deregisterBillingSchedule();
1718:         this.isUnenrollment = false;
1719:     }

101:     async create(
102:         createCustomerDto: CreateCustomerDto,
103:         subject: string,
104:         overridesForCustomer?: CustomOverrides,
105:     ): Promise<CreateCustomerResponseDto> {
106:         CustomerService.logger.log('Customer DTO', createCustomerDto);
107:         const res = await this.userEntitlements.determineIfEntitlementExceeded({
108:             subject,
109:             entitlementType: EntitlementTypes.CUSTOMERS,
110:         });
111:         if (res?.entitlementExceeded) {
112:             throw new ConflictException(
113:                 `Failed to create customer. Customer entitlement limit of ${res?.entitlementValue} has been reached.`,
114:             );
115:         }
116:         let customerId;
117:         if (createCustomerDto?.customerId) {
118:             const customerConfig = await this.InfluxService.getLatestCustomer({
119:                 businessID: createCustomerDto?.businessID,
120:                 customerId: createCustomerDto?.customerId,
121:             });
122:             if (customerConfig?.length) {
123:                 throw new BadRequestException(
124:                     `Failed to create customer. customerId: ${createCustomerDto.customerId} already exists.`,
125:                 );
126:             }
127:             customerId = createCustomerDto.customerId;
128:         } else {
129:             customerId = v4();
130:         }
131: 
132:         const { loadPoints } = this.InfluxService;
133:         const { businessID, offeringId, paymentChannel } = createCustomerDto;
134:         const stripeCustomerId = createCustomerDto.paymentChannelOptions?.stripeCustomerId;
135:         const [settingsEntity] = await this.settingsService.findAll({ businessID });
136:         const { accountState, stripeAccountId: businessStripeAccount } = settingsEntity;
137:         if (
138:             paymentChannel === PaymentChannel.Stripe &&
139:             (!stripeCustomerId || stripeCustomerId === '') &&
140:             (!businessStripeAccount || businessStripeAccount === '')
141:         ) {
142:             throw new BadRequestException(
143:                 `Failed to create customer. Must enable Stripe Connect in order to automatically add customer to Stripe.`,
144:             );
145:         }
146: 
147:         let contract: CreateContractResponseDto;
148:         if (offeringId) {
149:             contract = await this.contractService.create({
150:                 customerId,
151:                 offeringId,
152:                 businessID,
153:                 readSettingsResponseData: settingsEntity,
154:                 usageOverrides: createCustomerDto?.usage,
155:                 ...overridesForCustomer,
156:             });
157:         }
158:         let updatedStripeCustomerId: string;
159:         let portalUrl: string;
160:         const shouldCreateStripeCustomer = CustomerEntity.shouldCreateStripeCustomer({
161:             newCustomerPaymentChannel: createCustomerDto?.paymentChannel,
162:             newPaymentChannelOptions: createCustomerDto?.paymentChannelOptions,
163:         });
164:         if (shouldCreateStripeCustomer) {
165:             const results = await CustomerEntity.createStripeCustomer({
166:                 customerName: createCustomerDto?.customerName,
167:                 email: createCustomerDto?.email,
168:                 businessStripeAccount,
169:                 accountState,
170:             });
171:             updatedStripeCustomerId = results.stripeCustomerId;
172:             portalUrl = results.portalUrl;
173:         }
174:         const customerEntity = new CustomerEntity({
175:             ...createCustomerDto,
176:             freeTrialEndDate: contract?.overridesForOffering?.freeTrialEndDate,
177:             freeTrialStartDate: contract?.overridesForOffering?.freeTrialEndDate ? new Date().toISOString() : undefined,
178:             customerId,
179:             paymentChannelOptions: shouldCreateStripeCustomer
180:                 ? { stripeCustomerId: updatedStripeCustomerId }
181:                 : createCustomerDto?.paymentChannelOptions,
182:             creditBalance: contract?.prepaidCredit,
183:             offeringEnrollmentDate: contract?.offeringEnrollmentDate,
184:         });
185:         const points = CustomerEntity.transformer(customerEntity, this.InfluxService);
186:         await loadPoints(`${process.env.STAGE}-config`, process.env.INFLUX_ORG, points);
187: 
188:         if (contract) {
189:             await this.contractService.enrollCustomerInContract(
190:                 contract,
191:                 subject,
192:                 new ReadCustomerResponseData(customerEntity, [], contract),
193:             );
194:         }
195:         try {
196:             await this.tokenConsumerService.create({
197:                 subject,
198:                 businessID,
199:                 tokenAmount: '1',
200:                 metadata: {
201:                     tokenType: TokenType.customer,
202:                 },
203:             });
204:         } catch (e) {
205:             CustomerService.logger.error('Failed to meter token for customer', serializeError(e));
206:             AuditService.publishEvent({
207:                 topic: AuditScope.ERROR,
208:                 message: 'Failed to meter token for customer',
209:                 data: [{ customerId, businessID, error: serializeError(e) }],
210:             });
211:         }
212:         WebhookPublishingService.publishEvent({
213:             topic: WebhookProcessorEventType.Standard,
214:             type: WebhookType.CUSTOMER_CREATED,
215:             data: [
216:                 new ReadCustomerResponseData(
217:                     {
218:                         ...customerEntity,
219:                         freeTrialEndDate: (contract as ReadContractResponseDto)?.overridesForOffering?.freeTrialEndDate,
220:                         creditBalance: contract?.prepaidCredit,
221:                     },
222:                     [],
223:                     contract,
224:                 ),
225:             ],
226:             businessID,
227:         });
228:         return {
229:             message: 'New customer added',
230:             customerId: customerEntity.customerId,
231:             portalUrl,
232:         };
233:     }

235:     private async findInvoicesByCustomer({
236:         businessID,
237:         customerId,
238:         paymentChannel,
239:         paymentChannelOptions,
240:         settingsResponseData,
241:         getPaymentInfo = true,
242:         generateInvoicePaymentLink = false,
243:     }: {
244:         businessID: string;
245:         customerId: string;
246:         paymentChannel?: PaymentChannel;
247:         paymentChannelOptions?: StripePaymentChannelOptions;
248:         settingsResponseData?: ReadSettingsResponseData;
249:         getPaymentInfo: boolean;
250:         generateInvoicePaymentLink?: boolean;
251:     }) {
252:         CustomerService.logger.log(`Finding invoices for customer ${customerId} of business ${businessID}`);
253:         const invoiceDbModels = await this.InfluxService.getInvoicesForCustomer({ businessID, customerId });
254:         if (invoiceDbModels.length > 0) {
255:             const amountPaidForInvoices = await this.paymentService.getAmountPaidForCustomerInvoices({
256:                 customerId,
257:                 businessID,
258:             });
259:             let refundMap = {};
260:             let paymentMap = {};
261:             let mixedPaymentMap = {};
262:             if (getPaymentInfo) {
263:                 const { data: refundsForCustomer } = await this.findRefunds({
264:                     businessID,
265:                     customerId,
266:                     paymentChannel,
267:                     paymentChannelOptions,
268:                     accountState: settingsResponseData?.accountState,
269:                     stripeAccountId: settingsResponseData?.stripeAccountId,
270:                 });
271:                 refundMap = refundsForCustomer.reduce((acc, refund) => {
272:                     if (refund?.metadata?.invoiceId) {
273:                         if (!acc[refund.metadata?.invoiceId]) {
274:                             acc[refund.metadata?.invoiceId] = [];
275:                         }
276:                         acc[refund.metadata?.invoiceId].push(refund);
277:                     }
278:                     return acc;
279:                 }, {});
280: 
281:                 const { data: paymentsForCustomer } = await this.findPayments({
282:                     businessID,
283:                     customerId,
284:                     paymentChannel,
285:                     paymentChannelOptions,
286:                     accountState: settingsResponseData?.accountState,
287:                     stripeAccountId: settingsResponseData?.stripeAccountId,
288:                 });
289:                 paymentMap = paymentsForCustomer.reduce((acc, payment) => {
290:                     if (payment?.metadata?.invoiceId) {
291:                         if (!acc[payment.metadata?.invoiceId]) {
292:                             acc[payment.metadata?.invoiceId] = [];
293:                         }
294:                         acc[payment.metadata?.invoiceId].push(new ReadPaymentDto(payment));
295:                     }
296:                     return acc;
297:                 }, {});
298: 
299:                 const { data } = await this.creditService.getCreditLedger({ businessID, customerId });
300:                 mixedPaymentMap = data.reduce((acc, credit) => {
301:                     if (credit?.metadata?.invoiceId) {
302:                         if (!acc[credit.metadata?.invoiceId]) {
303:                             acc[credit.metadata?.invoiceId] = [];
304:                         }
305:                         acc[credit.metadata?.invoiceId].push(new ReadPaymentDto(credit));
306:                     }
307:                     return acc;
308:                 }, paymentMap);
309:             }
310:             const responseData = await Promise.all(
311:                 invoiceDbModels.map(async (dbModel) => {
312:                     const entity = Invoice.fromDBModel(dbModel);
313:                     if (generateInvoicePaymentLink) {
314:                         entity.paymentLink = await entity.generatePresignedUrl(
315:                             PresignedURLType.Payment,
316:                             this.localJWTAuthService,
317:                         );
318:                     }
319:                     const result = new CustomerInvoiceMetadata(entity);
320: 
321:                     result.amountPaid = amountPaidForInvoices[result.invoiceId] || 0;
322:                     if (getPaymentInfo) {
323:                         result.payments = mixedPaymentMap[result.invoiceId] || [];
324:                         result.payments = result.payments.sort(
325:                             (a, b) => new Date(a.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(b.timestamp).getTime(),
326:                         );
327:                         result.refunds = refundMap[result.invoiceId] || [];
328:                     }
329:                     return result;
330:                 }),
331:             );
332: 
333:             return { data: responseData, message: 'Found invoices for customer' };
334:         } else {
335:             return { data: [], message: 'No invoices found for customer' };
336:         }
337:     }

424:                         parent,
425:                     });
426:                     return res?.data?.[0];
427:                 }),
428:             );
429:             CustomerService.logger.debug(`Found ${response.length} customers for ${businessID}`);
430:             return {
431:                 data: response,

554:     private async buildReadCustomerResponse({
555:         customerConfig,
556:         customerId,
557:         businessID,
558:         getStripeInfo = true,
559:         settingsEntity,
560:         invoices,
561:         contract,
562:         balance,
563:         children,
564:         parent,
565:     }: {
566:         customerConfig: CustomerInfluxRow[] | CustomerEntity[];
567:         customerId: string;
568:         businessID: string;
569:         getStripeInfo?: boolean;
570:         settingsEntity: ReadSettingsResponseData;
571:         invoices: CustomerInvoiceMetadata[];
572:         contract?: ReadContractResponseDto | ReadContractResponseDto[];
573:         balance?: string;
574:         children?: ReadChildRowResponseData[];
575:         parent?: ReadChildRowResponseData;
576:     }): Promise<CustomerReadResponse> {
577:         if (customerConfig.length > 0) {
578:             let entity: CustomerEntity;
579:             //eslint-disable-next-line
580:             // @ts-ignore
581:             if (customerConfig[0]?._measurement === undefined) {
582:                 entity = customerConfig[0] as CustomerEntity;
583:             } else {
584:                 entity = CustomerEntity.dbModelToEntity(customerConfig[0] as CustomerInfluxRow);
585:             }
586: 
587:             // enrich with customer wallet
588:             let customerWalletBalance = balance;
589:             if (!customerWalletBalance) {
590:                 const { balance: foundBalance } = await this.creditService.findCreditBalance({
591:                     businessID,
592:                     customerId,
593:                 });
594:                 customerWalletBalance = foundBalance;
595:             }
596:             // enrich with payment information
597:             const paymentChannel = entity?.paymentChannel;
598:             const stripeCustomerId = entity?.paymentChannelOptions?.stripeCustomerId;
599:             let stripeAccountReady = undefined;
600:             if (paymentChannel === PaymentChannel.Stripe && stripeCustomerId && getStripeInfo) {
601:                 const { stripeAccountId: businessStripeAccount, accountState } = settingsEntity;
602:                 if (businessStripeAccount) {
603:                     try {
604:                         const customerObj = await CustomerEntity.getStripeCustomer(
605:                             stripeCustomerId,
606:                             businessStripeAccount,
607:                             accountState,
608:                         );
609:                         if (customerObj) {
610:                             stripeAccountReady = await CustomerEntity.stripeCustomerPaymentInfoComplete(customerObj);
611:                         } else {
612:                             stripeAccountReady = false;
613:                         }
614:                     } catch (e) {
615:                         CustomerService.logger.warn(e.statusCode === 404 ? 'Stripe customer not found' : e.message);
616:                         stripeAccountReady = false;
617:                     }
618:                 }
619:             }
620:             let responseData: ReadCustomerResponseData[];
621:             if (contract && Array.isArray(contract)) {
622:                 responseData = [
623:                     new ReadCustomerResponseData(
624:                         {
625:                             ...entity,
626:                             creditBalance: customerWalletBalance,
627:                             freeTrialEndDate: contract[0]?.overridesForOffering?.freeTrialEndDate,
628:                         },
629:                         invoices,
630:                         contract,
631:                         stripeAccountReady,
632:                         children,
633:                         parent,
634:                     ),
635:                 ];
636:             } else {
637:                 responseData = [
638:                     new ReadCustomerResponseData(
639:                         {
640:                             ...entity,
641:                             freeTrialEndDate: (contract as ReadContractResponseDto)?.overridesForOffering
642:                                 ?.freeTrialEndDate,
643:                             creditBalance: customerWalletBalance,
644:                         },
645:                         invoices,
646:                         contract,
647:                         stripeAccountReady,
648:                         children,
649:                         parent,
650:                     ),
651:                 ];
652:             }
653:             return {
654:                 data: responseData,
655:                 message: 'Found Customer',
656:             };
657:         } else {
658:             throw new NotFoundException(`Customer with ID: ${customerId} not found`);
659:         }
660:     }
